kjv: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

lines.say: Before you sleep, read these over your family.
lines.big: Before you sleep, read these over your family

lines.say: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day; Psalm ninety one, verses four and five.
lines.big: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

lines.say: His truth is your shield. The terror by night doesn't get the final say.

lines.say: Lord, cover me with your feathers tonight. I won't be afraid. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 79 through 104, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
